nodes.label: AppSumo Tier Mapping (Tier 1/2/3 to Plan Limits)
nodes.rationale: Tier 1 ($49-$59) = Growth plan; Tier 2 ($119-$149) = Professional plan; Tier 3 ($249+) = Agency/Enterprise. Allows LTD buyers to get lifetime access mapped to existing plan limits without Stripe.
nodes.norm_label: appsumo tier mapping (tier 1/2/3 to plan limits)

nodes.label: M1: Billing — Go-Live Blockers
nodes.rationale: Old Starter at $49 was underpriced vs competitors (Perfect Venue $119, Planning Pod $149). Price signals quality. New structure: Trial (free), Starter ($99), Growth ($199), Professional ($299), Enterprise (custom).

nodes.label: M10: Onboarding Flow — New User Activation
nodes.rationale: Users who complete activation steps within first 3 days are 3-4x more likely to convert to paid. 5-step checklist auto-hides after completion or 7 days to avoid nagging.

nodes.label: lib/context/VenueContext.tsx
nodes.rationale: Active venue stored in React Context + localStorage — no global state lib needed, persists across page refreshes

nodes.label: lib/utils/venueHeader.ts (X-Venue-Id header helper)
nodes.rationale: Active venue sent to API via X-Venue-Id request header — cleaner than query params, works uniformly across all routes

nodes.label: Multi-Venue Feature Gating (Professional+)
nodes.rationale: Multiple venues gated behind Professional+ tier. Starter/Trial users locked to 1 venue. Server-side RLS validates ownership — server never trusts the header alone.

nodes.label: AI Chat Conversation Flow (4 Stages)
nodes.rationale: 4-stage flow (Initial Understanding → Qualification → Refinement → Conversion) maps precisely to the lead qualification and booking journey; stages are intentional to incrementally capture structured event data while maintaining natural conversation

nodes.label: One Venue Per User Architectural Constraint
nodes.rationale: venues.owner_id UNIQUE constraint simplifies multi-tenancy at cost of scalability; chosen for MVP simplicity; public page editor needs no venue selector
nodes.norm_label: one venue per user architectural constraint

nodes.label: Supabase Edge Function: stripe-webhook
nodes.rationale: Using Supabase Edge Functions for Stripe webhooks instead of Vercel endpoints because they are more reliable; Vercel serverless has cold start and timeout issues for webhook processing

nodes.label: Marketplace Strategic Pivot (B2B to Two-Sided Marketplace)
nodes.rationale: Pivoting from pure B2B venue management SaaS to a two-sided marketplace to create network effects: more venues attract more seekers, more seekers attract more venues, compounding growth
nodes.norm_label: marketplace strategic pivot (b2b to two-sided marketplace)
